participation.context: Handed the book, answered the faults, and refused a new tally.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read standing, named the faults, and kept the fifty leaves.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Asked the count, and held the fee off today's line.
participation.name: John Heminges

relations.note: he takes the book and corrects the margins
relations.quote: You have a Wife, a Mother, and a Lady in the margin, and I take them for one woman.

story.body: You gave Garnish the book. He collapsed three women's names to the Lady, and he will head the fan-carrier's roll with the player's own name. Heminges took the count and left the fee for another day. The company did not read.

relations.note: he takes the book and corrects the margins
relations.quote: You have a Wife, a Mother, and a Lady in the margin, and I take them for one woman.

participation.context: Read the plot and did not take it back.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the three lines and did not add a fourth. The company was not called.

participation.context: Spoke Gaunt's line, and did not cross.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You played your speech from the public book. You did not open the three leaves, and you did not go to the Rose.

title: Spoke Gaunt's line from the public book
